DatasetFileMetaContentGet.description_en: The details of the retrieved dataset file metadata
DatasetFileMetaContentGet.description_zh: 获取的数据集文件元数据详情

Comment.example: The first image file in the dataset.
Comment.title: 注释

ContentType.description_en: The MIME type of the file. It includes a type and a subtype
ContentType.description_zh: 文件的 MIME 类型。包含 Type 和 SubType
ContentType.title: image/jpeg

DatasetFileMetaId.description_en: The ID of the dataset file metadata
DatasetFileMetaId.title: uuid

FileCreateTime.description_en: The time when the file was created. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
FileCreateTime.description_zh: 文件的创建时间，格式：ISO8601格式
FileCreateTime.title: 创建时间，格式：ISO8601格式

FileDir.description_en: The path of the folder where the OSS, NAS, or CPFS file is located
FileDir.title: oss/nas/cpfs文件所在目录的路径

FileFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the file. This value ensures the uniqueness of the file content. The value changes if the file content is modified. For OSS files, the ETag is used. For NAS files, the MD5 hash is used
FileFingerPrint.description_zh: 文件指纹值。用于确定文件内容的唯一性，文件内容修改后该值会发生变化。OSS文件使用ETag，NAS文件使用MD5值
FileFingerPrint.title: md5/oss etag

FileType.description_en: The file type. This is the same as the Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型。与 MIME Type 相同
FileType.title: 文件类型 image/audio/video/text

FileUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the file was last modified. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
FileUpdateTime.description_zh: 文件的最后修改时间，格式：ISO8601格式
FileUpdateTime.title: 修改时间，格式：ISO8601格式

MetaAttributes.description_en: The specific metadata of the file. This metadata cannot be used for retrieval. The format is a JSON string
MetaAttributes.description_zh: 文件的特定元数据，暂不具备检索能力。JSON String格式
MetaAttributes.title: JSON String，存储文件的基础元数据，暂不具备检索能力

SemanticIndexJobId.description_en: The ID of the job that builds the semantic index
SemanticIndexJobId.title: 语义索引构建的任务ID

SemanticIndexUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the semantic index was built
SemanticIndexUpdateTime.title: 语义索引构建的时间

TagUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the tag was last modified. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
TagUpdateTime.description_zh: 标签最后修改时间，格式iso8601
TagUpdateTime.title: 标签最后修改时间，格式iso8601

Tags.description_en:
A collection of tags for the metadata. It includes the following groups:

Algorithm tag group:

ai: A list of tag names aggregated from all algorithmic tagging tasks for a single metadata record.

User-defined tag group:

user: A list of tag names that a user adds to a single metadata record.

user-delete-ai-tags: A list of tag names from the algorithm tag group that the user wants to delete from a single metadata record
Tags.description_zh:
该元数据的标签合集，包括：
算法标签组：
ai: 对单个元数据，全部的算法打标任务汇总后的标签名列表。
用户自定义标签组：
user: 对单个元数据，用户自行添加的标签名列表。
user-delete-ai-tags: 对单个元数据，算法标签组中用户需要删除的标签名列表
Tags.example:
{
    "ai":
    [
        "Lane line",
        "Water horse",
        "Sunny day"
    ],
    "user":
    [
        "Everett",
        "Intelligent driving Dataset 1",
        "Cloudy day"
    ],
    "user-delete-ai-tags":
    [
        "Sunny day"
    ]
}
Tags.title: 标签组(json格式)

Uri.description_en:
The unique URI of the file. This URI records the unique path of the file. Paths for files in OSS and NAS are supported.

<details>

<summary>

OSS

</summary>

oss\://${bucket}/${path}

</details>

<details>

<summary>

NAS

</summary>

nas\://${fileSystemId}/${path}

</details>
Uri.description_zh:
文件唯一URI。用于记录文件唯一路径。支持OSS、NAS下的文件路径。
<details>
<summary>OSS</summary>
oss://${bucket}/${path}
</details>
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
nas://${fileSystemId}/${path}
</details>
Uri.title: oss/nas/cpfs uri
